project.name: Tetherloom
project.description: Self-hosted secure overlay network. The management server is one process with embedded storage, a local control socket and an HTTPS endpoint for setup and sign-in.

deb.repoSetup:
curl -fsSL https://repo.sw.foundation/keys/sw.gpg | sudo gpg --dearmor -o /etc/apt/keyrings/sw.gpg
echo "deb [signed-by=/etc/apt/keyrings/sw.gpg] https://repo.sw.foundation/deb $(lsb_release -cs) main" | sudo tee /etc/apt/sources.list.d/sw.list
sudo apt-get update
